useCases.title: Agent notified of status changes
mainFlow: The agent receives an e-mail whenever the status of their booking request changes.

useCases.title: E-mail notification includes the booking reference (workshop-only, not in the chapter)
mainFlow: Agents want the e-mail notifications to include the reference.
useCases.notes: Raised in workshop-notes.md Session 2, not stated in 17-notifications.md's own prose. Treated as a detail of UC001, not a separate feature. See openQuestions OQ-6.

useCases.title: Officer daily digest
mainFlow: Officers receive a daily digest at 06:00 listing requests with an ETA within the next 48 hours.

openQuestions.question: Should the agent status-change e-mail include the booking reference in its body/subject (workshop-notes.md Session 2)?
openQuestions.assumption: Yes — include the Reference in the notification; it is a small, unambiguous addition agents explicitly asked for and does not conflict with anything in the numbered chapters.
